display_title: The Point that Touches the Fingertips

titles.title: The Point that Touches the Fingertips

description:
*Straightforward guy photo and college student Kang Chan X prickly former pianist Ye-Jun. A love story that is louder than music begins!*

Kang Chan was forcibly dragged to his nephew's piano recital as a cameraman. The moment he was bored while holding the camera— delicate fingertips, eyes that you can't take your eyes off, overwhelming melody. His eyes, his heart, stopped at the man playing the piano on stage. *"Please be my photo model!"*

Straightforward from their first meeting. Manners? None. The mood? Smashed. Of course, Ye-Jun rejects him outright! But Kang Chan doesn't know how to give up. He immediately enrolls in a piano academy and starts to hover around Ye-Jun. Bickering, excitement explosion! 

A love story clearer than a camera, starting now.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
